heroCommands.command:
git clone https://github.com/hpcaitech/Open-Sora
cd Open-Sora
pip install -v .

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Open-Sora is an open-source video generation model and toolkit from HPC-AI Tech. Its 11B Open-Sora 2.0 model turns text prompts or images into short videos, and the project publishes checkpoints, training code and technical reports.
sixtySeconds.problem: High-quality video generation has mostly been locked inside commercial products. Open-Sora makes the model, training pipeline and details open so anyone can generate, fine-tune or study video models.
whoFor: Developers with strong GPUs exploring text-to-video
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a fully open video model with weights, training code and reports. The README reports Open-Sora 2.0 performing on par with 11B HunyuanVideo and 30B Step-Video on VBench and human preference.
requirements: Large disk space for the 11B checkpoint

overview: The 11B model supports 256px and 768px resolution, and one model handles both text-to-video and image-to-video. It is optimised for image-to-video, so its text-to-video path first creates an image with the Flux text-to-image model and then animates it; direct text-to-video is also available.

Install into a Python 3.10 environment, add xformers and flash-attn, then download weights from Hugging Face or ModelScope into ./ckpts. Generate with torchrun and a config file; options set aspect ratio and number of frames, and --offload True saves memory. 768px on multiple GPUs uses ColossalAI sequence parallelism.
Older versions live in separate branches. The project is Apache 2.0 licensed.

steps.title: Create an environment
steps.code:
conda create -n opensora python=3.10
conda activate opensora

steps.title: Get the code and install
steps.body: Make sure torch is 2.4.0 or newer.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/hpcaitech/Open-Sora
cd Open-Sora
pip install -v .

steps.title: Install attention libraries
steps.body: Pick the xformers build for your CUDA version.
steps.code:
pip install xformers==0.0.27.post2 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
pip install flash-attn --no-build-isolation
